propositions: ExpressionError (execute-time expression-resolution failure for unset inputs, missing step outputs, out-of-scope loop vars, missing secrets/env, unresolvable templates) currently maps to llm_unavailable via WorkflowError base class, falsely asserting a provider outage
error_code_for branch ordering causes ExpressionError to inherit llm_unavailable instead of a caller/state-fault code like invalid_input, encouraging retries on non-transient wiring bugs
ExpressionError must be reclassified to a dedicated error_code attribute so it maps to invalid_input and the mapping fires before the broad LLMError→llm_unavailable fallback
genuine execute-time LLM outages (raised as LLMUnavailableError) must continue to map to llm_unavailable to preserve dbca AC3 and avoid masking real provider failures

implementation requires adding invalid_input error_code as explicit ExpressionError attribute, updating KNOWN_ERROR_CODES and taxonomy contract test, and verifying both wiring-fault and genuine-outage paths through run_workflow surface
